label: 全部物品：冒险背包与小物件
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: FantasyFinal Chinese fantasy RPG inventory category tab icon, single raster PNG asset.
Primary request: A beautifully illustrated cute adventurer's leather backpack with a little rolled parchment and two small travel objects peeking out, the clear symbol for all inventory items.
Style/medium: Japanese light anime, chibi hand-painted game item icon; soft rounded proportions, polished painterly shading, clean warm brown contour lines. Friendly storybook fantasy, consistent with a sunny anime RPG village. Detailed material highlights but a clear compact silhouette that remains readable at 20–28 pixels.
Color palette: warm honey brown leather, cream warm gold fastenings, a restrained turquoise teal accent. Soft warm illumination.
Composition/framing: One centered object group in a square canvas; the complete backpack plus its small contents occupy approximately 70 percent of canvas width/height, leaving at least 15 percent clean empty margin on every edge. Slight three-quarter view, chunky front flap and prominent gold clasp.
Scene/backdrop: Truly transparent alpha background, isolated cutout.
Constraints: Generate exactly one inventory icon, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no decorative UI frame, no tile or disc behind the subject, no scene, no border, no ground plane, no cast shadow outside the object, no SVG or vector look. Background pixels must be transparent, never a drawn checkerboard or a white backdrop.
